experiments.title: Forge2D Physics Test
experiments.description: Scratch experiment for tuning the Forge2D reaction layer — not a real chemistry experiment, just a rig for testing the physics overlays before touching the real Firestore-backed screen.
safetyPrecautions: This is a test rig — no real chemicals involved.

steps.instruction: Frame the beaker (or tap "I don't have this equipment").

steps.label: Water
steps.instruction: Add water to establish a fill level.

steps.label: Baking Soda
steps.instruction: Add baking soda — watch it drop and pile via Forge2D, not just tint the water.
Trigger the reaction to see the eruption physics layer.

steps.explanation: The baking soda grains piled at the bottom used the same Forge2D world as the eruption burst — both are real rigid-body physics, not scripted CustomPainter animation.
steps.realWorldConnection: In a real lab, undissolved solid settling before a reaction kicks off is a genuine visual cue students learn to read.
